sahneler.metin: On its maiden voyage, the iron clipper Tayleur ran aground off Ireland.
It struck rocks on Lambay Island, and hundreds were killed.
The crew had followed their compasses.
But the ship's iron hull disturbed them.
The compasses hadn't been properly corrected.
In poor visibility, the error went unnoticed.
The ship headed straight for the island.
It pushed research into correcting compasses on iron ships.

aciklama:
Tayleur ran aground on its maiden voyage. The cause: magnetic deviation from an iron hull that the compasses were not corrected for.
